manifest_row.title: We Can't Afford Five More Years of BP-Sponsored Culture

screening.main_topic: The controversy over BP’s sponsorship of cultural institutions and the role of arts organizations in responding to fossil fuel companies and climate action.
screening.climate_relevance: The text connects BP’s sponsorship to climate change, the Paris climate deal, fossil fuel expansion, and opposition to climate action. Climate responsibility is a substantial part of the argument about whether cultural institutions should accept BP’s money.
screening.reason: Although the article focuses on cultural sponsorship, it develops a sustained climate-related argument about BP’s fossil fuel business and lobbying, and about the responsibility of museums and galleries to take climate action.
